title: The oo Team
rule: The letters oo work as a team and have two sounds: moon and book. We code both the same way: underline both letters. Your ear decides the sound.
trickText: Two o's side by side are a team. Underline both letters. Whether it sounds like moon or like book, we code it the same.
say: Today's case: the oo team. It has two sounds, like in moon and in book. But we code both the same way. Underline both letters, and let your ears decide the sound.

example.say: Look at moon. The two o's are a team. Underline both letters. Book is coded the very same way.

activities.instruction: Code each word. Underline the oo team. Short vowels get a breve.
Bonus: listen to the oo sound. Is it the moon sound or the book sound?

categories.label: Moon sound
categories.why: Your ear hears the long oo, like in moon.

categories.label: Book sound
categories.why: Your ear hears the short oo, like in book.
